description: This file defines a configuration class for integrating Databricks chat models with a system that interfaces with OpenAI and Anthropic models. It includes methods for transforming messages, handling responses, and managing model-specific parameters and behaviors.

classes.name: DatabricksConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Databricks chat models, including methods for message transformation, response parsing, and parameter mapping.

classes.name: DatabricksChatResponseIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for streaming and processing Databricks chat model responses.

methods.name: convert_anthropic_tool_to_databricks_tool
methods.description: Converts an Anthropic tool representation into a DatabricksTool object.

methods.name: _map_openai_to_dbrx_tool
methods.description: Maps OpenAI-style tools to Databricks tools, with special handling for Claude models.

methods.name: map_response_format_to_databricks_tool
methods.description: Converts response format to a Databricks tool representation.

methods.name: _transform_messages
methods.description: Transforms messages for Databricks, including handling cache control and message formatting.

methods.name: extract_content_str
methods.description: Extracts string content from Databricks content values.

methods.name: extract_reasoning_content
methods.description: Extracts reasoning text and thinking blocks from content.

methods.name: transform_response
methods.description: Transforms raw HTTP responses into structured model responses.

methods.name: get_model_response_iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for streaming model responses.
